title: Eleven Sheets, Rewritten by Hand
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：version　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 version 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The first ① version of the programme was written in 1961 on eleven sheets of paper, and it ran for thirty-one years without being touched, which my grandfather said was the whole point of it and the reason it never broke, and no version survives the man who wrote it. His ② version of what happened in 1974, and the county's, disagree on exactly one thing: whether anybody had asked him to change it.

The ③ latest version, meaning the one they bought in 1989 for eleven thousand pounds, did what his did and cost four hundred times as much, and it broke in the second week. At the inquiry, his ④ version of events was eleven sentences long; theirs was four hundred pages, and the four hundred pages said nothing at all about 1974.

There is a ⑤ version of this story in which he was right, and one in which he was merely obstinate, and I have held both, and I am forty-one and I now hold the second. In 1994 they made a ⑥ version of it in another language, and in the translation it lost eleven days of everybody's wages, and nobody ever said whose fault that was.

He kept an ⑦ updated version on paper until 1998, eleven sheets, rewritten by hand every year, and he said a programme you cannot read is a programme you do not have. The ⑧ version of the future he believed in was a dull one: the same programme, the same eleven sheets, and nobody asking him to change it.

The ⑨ version running now, at the county, is the fourth; it was written in 2011 by people who never met him, and it does what his did, and every version, he had said, is a promise you have not kept yet. His ⑩ version of the whole thing, which he told me once, in 1998, was that the machine was never the difficulty, and that the difficulty was always the eleven people who wanted it to be different.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 版本；版次（程序、书、文件）
B. n. 变体；（同一事物的）不同面貌
C. n. （某人对事情的）说法；描述
D. n. 译本；改写本；另一种语言的版本
E. 固定搭配：the latest / newest version 最新版本
F. 固定搭配：a version of ... ……的一个版本／一种面貌
G. 固定搭配：version of events 对事件的说法
H. 固定搭配：an updated version 更新版；升级版

items.q: The first version of the programme
His version of what happened in 1974
The latest version, meaning the one
his version of events was eleven sentences
There is a version of this story
they made a version of it in another
He kept an updated version on paper
The version of the future he believed in
The version running now, at the county
His version of the whole thing

answers.why: the first version 意为“第一个版本”，程序的第一版 1961 年写在十一张纸上。
his version of what happened 意为“他对事情的说法”，他与郡里对 1974 年发生的事说法不一。
the latest version 意为“最新版本”，1989 年他们花一万一千镑买下的那个最新版本。
version of events 意为“对事件的说法”，在调查会上，他对事件的说法只有十一句话。
a version of this story 意为“这个故事的一种面貌／变体”，这个故事有一个他是对的的版本，也有一个他只是固执的版本。
a version of it in another language 意为“另一种语言的版本、改写本”，1994 年他们把它改成了另一种语言的版本。
an updated version 意为“更新版、升级版”，他手写到 1998 年的那个更新版，每年重抄一遍。
a version of the future 意为“未来的一种面貌／版本”，他相信的那个未来是平淡的一种。
the version 意为“（正在运行的）版本”，如今郡里跑的是第四版。
his version of the whole thing 意为“他对整件事的说法”，他对整件事的说法是：机器从来不是难事。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 程序的第一版 1961 年写在十一张纸上，三十一年没人动过。（version）
他对 1974 年发生的事的说法与郡里的说法只在一点上不同。（version）
1989 年他们买下的最新版本花了他们一万一千镑，第二周就坏了。（the latest version）
在调查会上，他对事件的说法只有十一句话。（version of events）
1994 年他们把它改成了另一种语言的版本，结果弄丢了所有人十一天的工资。（version）
他手写到 1998 年的那个更新版，每年重抄一遍。（an updated version）
answers: The first version of the programme was written in 1961 on eleven sheets of paper and ran for thirty-one years without being touched.
His version of what happened in 1974 and the county's disagree on exactly one thing.
The latest version, the one they bought in 1989, cost them eleven thousand pounds and broke in the second week.
At the inquiry his version of events was eleven sentences long.
In 1994 they made a version of it in another language, and it lost eleven days of everybody's wages.
He kept an updated version on paper until 1998, rewritten by hand every year.
